provenance.bundle: esbuild minified in-memory production source; React external, CSS empty; private native symbols exposed only in harness.

scope.measured: Native CPU stepGame and separately 10 Hz HUD snapshot. Eight actual mission worlds, both original and stress-scheduled authored enemies.
scope.survivalFixture: Native health/maxHealth retained; player invulnerability set to 1e6 seconds. Simulation, geometry, AI, collision and enemy damage/death stay enabled.
scope.input: Deterministic normalized keyboard InputHub commands; no physical input device, DOM, renderer, asset loading or audio.
scope.stressSchedule: All-waves scenario moves existing mission wave activation to t=0, kills up to three real actors through damageEnemy, retains other native enemies.
scope.memory: Before/after process heap samples are informational, not a leak qualification.
scope.guard: Generous CPU regression guard for this CI runner; not a whole-frame/FPS, GPU, phone or controller certification.
unqualified: target physical hardware and thermal behavior
